description: Na₃MgP₂HO₈ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to one H and eight O atoms. The Na-H bond length is 2.55 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.86 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.49 Å. Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.03-2.13 Å. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 20-44°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.57 Å. H is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent O atoms. Both H-O bond lengths are 1.20 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na, one Mg, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one P, and one H atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one P atom.
